name: polygon-pack
description: The no-fit-polygon placement and genetic-algorithm engine used by SVGnest.

scripts.build: npm --workspace poygon-pack-algo run build && rollup --config ./rollup.config.mjs && cp ../poygon-pack-algo/pkg/poygon_pack_algo_bg.wasm ../../apps/desktop/src/renderer/public/workers/poygon_pack_algo_bg.wasm
scripts.check: node -e "console.log('Algorithm browser sources are syntax-preserved during migration.')"
